name: NZ78
source:
NZ78 is a short atmospheric sci-fi visual novel set in New Zealand in 2078. After overseas communication suddenly stops, ordinary explanations begin to fail, and the country is forced to confront an impossible situation. The story is told through text and ink-wash style images, with simple page navigation rather than action gameplay.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4125810/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《NZ78》是一部极具氛围感的短篇科幻视觉小说，背景设定在2078年的新西兰。当海外通讯毫无征兆地彻底中断后，一切常规解释都开始失效，整个国家被迫直面一场匪夷所思的危机。本作以文字搭配水墨风格插画娓娓道来，采用简洁的翻页阅读模式，不含动作操作玩法。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4125810/]Steam[/url]]
